component.name: LibreWard
component.summary: Virus scanning, live protection and firewall made simple

description.p: LibreWard protects your computer with plain choices instead of technical settings. It uses the open-source ClamAV antivirus engine, which is developed separately by the ClamAV project and Cisco Talos.

ul.li: Scan folders or the most common places for viruses, with clear results
Live protection checks new downloads in the background, also when the window is closed, and asks what to do with a dangerous file
Move dangerous files to quarantine and restore them if needed
Block dangerous, advertising or adult websites on the whole computer
Turn the firewall on and allow your local network

description.p: LibreWard changes system settings such as the firewall and DNS only after you confirm, and asks for your password through the system dialog.
First release with virus scanning, quarantine, firewall management and Internet protection.
